source: https://www.beauyounghandshaped.com/shop (Squarespace shop — excludes fins, fin sets, and T-shirts)

brands.name: Beau Young Surfboards
brands.short_description: Handcrafted surfboards by Beau Young. Official homepage copy says each board is a unique work of art, and no two are exactly the same.

models.name: Wombat Mark 11
models.description: The Wombat Mk11 is the successor to Beau Young's original best-selling Wombat. Official copy says it keeps the same wave-catching ability and maneuverability, with more curve and rocker for tighter turning and vertical maneuvers, plus a narrower nose and tail so the board feels less bulky. Stock sizes 5'4" to 8'0". Ridden as a 2+1 or a quad. Works in 1–6 foot surf, from full and slow waves to hollow and fast.

models.name: Sea Hawk
models.description: The Seahawk is a modern take on a 1970s fish. Official copy calls out medium rocker, a round forgiving rail, and a subtle vee bottom, with added curve and a narrower nose than a traditional fish. Five-fin boxes cover thruster, quad, or twin-plus-stabilizer. Stock sizes 5'4" to 7'8". Tight, smooth turns without losing momentum in 1–8 foot surf.

models.name: Cheetah
models.description: Named for the fastest land animal, the Cheetah is Beau Young's small-wave speed board. Official copy says ride it a couple of inches shorter than a regular board: wider through the nose, tail, and wide point, with a single-to-double concave for speed and looseness. Five-fin plugs allow quad, thruster, or twin-plus-stabilizer. Available 5'2"–6'8". Built for poor, lacklustre conditions, not a 1970s retro remake.

models.name: Pendulum Swing
models.description: The Pendulum is the most versatile and best-selling longboard in the official Beau Young range. Soft forgiving rails, curves, and foam distribution, with a wide nose and tail for stability through turns and noserides. Nose concave and a vee bottom for a traditional log. Stock sizes 9'0" to 10'6". Official copy says it performs best from six-inch slop to shoulder-high surf.

models.name: RH - Robert Harold Nat Young
models.description: With Nat Young's blessing, the RH moulds the best aspects of Nat's boards from 1963–1966. Official copy describes a rolled bottom for smooth turns, slightly knifey 50/50 rails that keep momentum and trim, and a big 10.5" fin with Nat Young / Bob McTavish / George Greenough inspired flex and rake. Available 9'1" to 9'6" (larger on request). Single-fin box, polished finish.

models.name: Cloudwalker
models.description: The Cloudwalker is the fastest longboard Beau Young says he has ever ridden, built for tiny summer slop. Official copy calls it a round-rail, fair-volume log that tapers in the nose and tail, with a flip in the last four inches of the tail and even concave under the front quarter for noserides. Available 9'1" to 9'6" (larger on request). Single-fin box, matt finish, old-school competition band.

models.name: Kiora
models.description: Kiora was the board Beau Young rode to his second world title in New Zealand. Official copy says this three-fin longboard turns in the pocket and still noserides, with a hard edge through the tail and subtle curve through the whole board. Available 9'1" to 9'6" (larger on request). Mid-lightweight glassing, tinted matt finish, box plus FCS II side-fin plugs. Kiora means hello in Māori.

models.name: Zen Sled
models.description: The Zen Sled is a funboard designed purely for getting out in the ocean. Official copy describes a simple outline and bottom, quite wide and thick, with a fantastic overall curve that makes catching waves and turning easy. Ranges from 6'6" through 8'1". Ridden as a single, quad, or 2+1. Best in 1–5 foot surf, slow or fast. Single-fin box plus quad plugs, matt finish.

models.name: 72 Evolution
models.description: The Nat Young 72 Evolution is a mid-length single fin (optional side fins) made with Nat's blessing after the early-to-mid 1970s boards of Nat, Ted Spencer, Bob McTavish, George Greenough, and Russell Hughes. Official copy says the wide point is forward, with a soft edge through the tail, subtle vee, and a rounded nose. Available 6'6" to 7'8". Turns like a small single-fin longboard. Matt finish.
